events.title: Landfall
events.text: The Meridian's crew section tore free and came down on an unknown world. Eight survivors crawl from the hull. MERIDIAN, the colony intelligence, wakes with them.

events.title: First Storm Front
events.text: A wall of black cloud rolls over the ridge. Anyone caught outside will need shelter.

events.title: Roots
events.text: The first season has passed. The survivors begin to speak of staying rather than surviving.

events.title: The Long Frost
events.text: The temperature falls and keeps falling. Fires must burn and food must last.

events.title: The Signal
events.text: Every radio in the colony picks up the same pulse, repeating from beneath the plain.

events.title: The Migration
events.text: The native herds are moving, and the colony stands in their path. Crops wither in their wake.

events.title: Divergence
events.text: The colony knows enough now to choose what it will become. The council must hear a proposal.

events.title: Dissent
events.text: Not everyone agrees with the path chosen. Arguments run late into the night.

events.title: The Final Landing
events.text: The last project begins. Whatever the colony becomes, it becomes now.

events.title: Static from the Deep
events.text: The array draws the sky's anger: ion storms batter the colony as the beacon charges.

events.title: Root Fever
events.text: The network tests the colony. Fever spreads and crops sicken as the roots reach in.

events.title: The Spire Wakes
events.text: The ground hums. Ancient guardians crawl from the spire's vents.

events.title: Skitter Raid
events.text: A pack of skitters slips in to raid the stores.

events.title: Skitter Swarm
events.text: Dozens of chittering skitters pour over the ridge.

events.title: Ridgeback Hunt
events.text: A pair of ridgebacks has caught the colony's scent.

events.title: Driftmaw
events.text: Something enormous moves through the long grass.

events.title: Storm Front
events.text: Thunderheads stack over the horizon.

events.title: Cold Snap
events.text: A bitter wind drives the temperature down.

events.title: Heatwave
events.text: The air shimmers. Work slows under the pale sun.

events.title: Ashfall
events.text: The volcanoes to the south breathe out. Grey ash falls like snow.

events.title: Escape Pod
events.text: A Meridian escape pod streaks down nearby. Its passenger is alive.

events.title: Survivor Band
events.text: A ragged group of Meridian survivors walks out of the wilds.

events.title: Fever
events.text: A fever spreads through the bunks.

events.title: Blight
events.text: Grey rot spreads through the crops overnight.

events.title: Meteor Shower
events.text: Debris from the Meridian's orbit falls as burning salvage.

events.title: Supply Cache
events.text: A sealed crate of spare parts is found wedged in the hull.

events.title: Cargo Pod
events.text: A cargo pod from the Meridian lands intact.

events.title: Aurora
events.text: The sky burns green and gold all night. Nobody sleeps; nobody minds.

events.title: Tremor
events.text: The ground shakes. Walls crack and stores spill.

events.title: Strange Spores
events.text: Glowing spores drift over the fields. The botanists are fascinated.

events.title: Ruin Echo
events.text: The ruins sing for a moment, and someone writes the tune down.

events.title: Old Manuals
events.text: A data slate full of engineering manuals turns up in the wreck.

events.title: Lost Transmission
events.text: A fragment of the Meridian's science database decrypts itself.

events.title: Distant Smoke
events.text: Smoke rises far to the east. Someone else survived.

events.title: Glinting Ridge
events.text: Scouts report a ridge that glitters at dusk.

events.title: Answering the Signal
events.text: Drawn by the colony's signal, a straggler from the Meridian's scattered pods limps into camp.

expedition_sites.name: Fibre Valley
expedition_sites.description: A sheltered valley thick with fibre reeds and wild food.

expedition_sites.name: Wreck Field
expedition_sites.description: Debris from the Meridian scattered over a mile of scrub.

expedition_sites.name: Fallen Lifeboat
expedition_sites.description: A lifeboat's beacon still pings from the hills.

expedition_sites.name: Northern Caves
expedition_sites.description: Deep caves veined with ore and strange carvings.

expedition_sites.name: Survivor Camp
expedition_sites.description: Smoke from another group of Meridian survivors.

expedition_sites.name: Precursor Ruins
expedition_sites.description: Collapsed towers of something that was here first.

expedition_sites.name: Crystal Ridge
expedition_sites.description: A ridge of resonant crystal and rich metal seams.

expedition_sites.name: Spire's Shadow
expedition_sites.description: The base of the buried spire, where the signal is loudest.
